title.narrative: Brazil: Support to New Bolsa Familia Conditional Cash Transfer Program

description.narrative: The objective of the Project is to protect the income of poor families with children from 0 to 6 years of age and mitigate risks that might damage those children's human capital.

The project supports scaling up of conditional cash transfers by supporting an additional benefit for children from 0 to 6 years of age living in poor families (US$300 million). The project consists of a single component to finance the First Childhood Benefit of the new Bolsa Familia Program paid to families that have members in specific age groups: 0-6 who are being monitored for fulfilling with human capital conditionalities, and meet the income eligibility criteria.
